attributes.title: NJSSNA 2027 Annual Conference: Relentless School Nursing for Student Success
attributes.venue: Hilton East Brunswick Hotel & Executive Meeting Center
attributes.organizer: New Jersey State School Nurses Association
attributes.summary:
The New Jersey State School Nurses Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference on February 5 and 6, 2027, at the Hilton East Brunswick. It starts with a Friday-evening session on the legal landscape of school health and continues Saturday with a keynote, general sessions, breakouts, posters and an exhibit hall.

NJSSNA lists up to 7.0 contact hours: 1 for the Friday evening and up to 6 on Saturday, with poster viewing counting toward the total. The accrediting body and registration fees are not stated on the conference page. Saturday topics include individualized healthcare and emergency care plans, vaccine-preventable diseases, diabetes technology and behavioral health.
